sql:
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    t.Price / t.Amount AS avg_price_per_item
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY 
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1
